title: Local generation model
requirement: Provide one open-weight text generation model that runs on the host's single 24 GB GPU beside an embedding model, as the local fallback for agent services when the hosted model route is unavailable, with reliable structured output and tool calling through an OpenAI-compatible local server.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: On the RTX 4090 through one local server: structured-output validity and tool-call success on a fixed task set, answer quality on a public benchmark subset, tokens per second and peak GPU memory with the embedding model loaded.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
